author_or_org: Emma Casolin, Flora D. Salim, Ben Newell

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Explainable AI aims to support appropriate human-AI reliance by increasing the interpretability of complex model decisions.
claims.quote: Explainable AI (XAI) aims to support appropriate human-AI reliance by increasing the interpretability of complex model decisions.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: There is mixed evidence surrounding the effects of different styles of XAI explanations on human-AI reliance.
claims.quote: Despite the proliferation of proposed methods, there is mixed evidence surrounding the effects of different styles of XAI explanations on human-AI reliance.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Interpreting conflicting findings requires understanding the individual and combined qualities of different explanation styles that influence appropriate and inappropriate human-AI reliance, and the role of interpretability.
claims.quote: Interpreting these conflicting findings requires an understanding of the individual and combined qualities of different explanation styles that influence appropriate and inappropriate human-AI reliance, and the role of interpretability in this interaction.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The study investigates feature-based, example-based, and combined feature- and example-based XAI methods on human-AI reliance through a two-part experimental study with 274 participants comparing these explanation style conditions.
claims.quote: In this study, we investigate the influences of feature-based, example-based, and combined feature- and example-based XAI methods on human-AI reliance through a two-part experimental study with 274 participants comparing these explanation style conditions.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Findings suggest differences between feature-based and example-based explanation styles beyond interpretability that affect human-AI reliance patterns across differences in individual performance and task complexity.
claims.quote: Our findings suggest differences between feature-based and example-based explanation styles beyond interpretability that affect human-AI reliance patterns across differences in individual performance and task complexity.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The work highlights the importance of adapting explanations to specific users and context over maximizing broad interpretability.
claims.quote: Our work highlights the importance of adapting explanations to their specific users and context over maximising broad interpretability.
